Hi Liza — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Call recap:
- Scope: BanyanHealth plans to integrate Redwood inference for document summarization + PII redaction across two pilot teams (Clinical Ops, Research).
- Drivers: Reduce manual tagging time, accelerate chart review. Security & data residency are gating items.
- Decision team: Procurement (you), Legal (Mark Reed), Finance (banking), Clinical Ops PO (TBD).

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (draft):
1) Procurement intake & vendor enrollment (owner: BanyanHealth procurement) — Deliverables: completed intake form, Ariba supplier registration, W-9 on file. Target: 2026-09-16
2) Security review & questionnaire (owner: Redwood/Redwood SRE + BanyanHealth security) — Deliverables: completed questionnaire, SOC2 attest. Target: 2026-09-20
3) Contract (owner: Redwood legal + BanyanHealth legal) — Deliverables: redline turn, counter-signed MSA + SOW. Target: 2026-09-24
4) Finance onboarding & bank verification (owner: BanyanHealth finance) — Deliverables: ACH/bank form, vendor code assigned. Target: 2026-09-27
5) Pilot kickoff (owner: Redwood delivery + BanyanHealth PO) — Target: 2026-10-04

Dependencies / blockers:
- Ariba/Coupa supplier code required before contract countersignature.
- W-9 and banking details required for payment terms (Net30 preferred).
- Security questionnaire turnaround (need your security team contact).

Attachments: Draft MAP - BanyanHealth v1.xlsx (attached) — this is a working file, please flag edits.

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm the primary procurement contact and the Ariba/Coupa intake process for Banyan?
2) Can Legal confirm whether you need a vendor form beyond our standard MSA (e.g., custom PO rules)?
3) Would you be able to target the procurement intake step completed by 2026-09-16, or should we shift dates?

I copied Ben (finance ops) and Marissa (solutions) to help expedite docs. Happy to hop on a short 20-min follow-up tomorrow if helpful.

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear recap. Appreciate the MAP draft; a couple of notes from procurement and legal.

Procurement intake notes:
- Please complete our Procurement Intake Form (attached) and return with a corporate W-9 and the vendor banking details (ACH remit).
- We use Ariba; vendor registration must include Tax ID and ACH onboarding. If Redwood already has a supplier code with our Ariba instance, please share it.
- We typically require banking verification (voided check or bank letter) before creating vendor codes.

Legal / timing:
- Legal would like to review our standard PO flow vs your MSA. Mark will coordinate redlines; expect initial comments within 3 business days after we receive the intake items.
- FYI: Finance has an internal budget freeze window starting 2026-09-25. If we want payment set-up before the freeze, procurement intake + W-9 needs to be completed by 2026-09-23.

Attachments: Procurement Intake Form.pdf (filled sample), Banyan procurement checklist.
